title: Computational cognitive modeling, Spring 2024 (NYU PSYCH-GA 3405.004 / DS-GA 1016.003)
description: Archived site and GitHub repository of the Spring 2024 offering co-taught by Brenden Lake and Todd Gureckis (TAs Solim LeGris and Cindy Luo). Fourteen lectures with PDF slides: introduction; neural networks and deep learning (two parts); reinforcement learning (three parts); Bayesian modeling (two parts); model comparison and fitting; categorization; probabilistic graphical models; program induction and language-of-thought models; information sampling and active learning; computational cognitive neuroscience. Also a lab schedule, readings per topic and four homework sets as Jupyter notebooks (homework-NeuralNet, homework-RL, homework-Bayes, homework-Categorization). The repository lists pre-recorded lecture videos from Spring 2022 on Vimeo.
